description: Designs a feature before code and produces its specification and implementation plan: how people use it (scenarios, states, errors, texts), how it works inside (data, failures, recovery, maintenance) and the steps with tests, grounded in research and sized to the project. For user-facing features (web, mobile, bots, AI agents and their tools, APIs) and internal mechanisms (backups, sync, queues, integrations). Use when the owner asks to work out, design, plan or write up a feature («прорабатываем», «спроектируй», «распиши фичу и план», «продумай или накидай, как сделать», «проверь план на дыры») or to build a new feature with no agreed plan yet. Not for discussing an idea («давай обсудим», «что думаешь»), a small point change (a button, a field, an option, a clear fix), a bug fix unless asked to work it out, or visual styling. The owner may write in any language; match on meaning.
